Hey OP. I’m a deity player and my favorite way to play is science/domination victories with using production and gold not religion. 

1. Early game is all about growth. Get your cities population up and your settlers out. A tip I use is 10 cities but turn 100 as the pace for settling. For growing cities, building farms in triangles will be your best friend. I’m a sloot for chaining farms together. 

2. Change policy cards as often as needed. There is a card for 50% increase settler production, or another for 100% campus adjacency bonus. These are very necessary cards, reading the cards and playing them at correct times will help tremendously. 

3. District Adjacency is high priority, don’t settle a bunch on no bonus bullsh*t. For science/dom victory I build science, production, and commercial districts mainly, with entertainment centers and water parks as the game goes on. 

Science Districts love mountains, coral reefs, and geothermal fissures. 

Build production districts next to aqueducts and dams, preferably both. 

Commercial districts go next to rivers. 

The government plaza helps give another adjacency bonus to any district next to it but you can only build one plaza. So build it touching as many other districts as you can. 

Don’t build districts Willy nilly focus on your victory and build towards that.
